source.rule: Narrative facts, names, aliases, locations and movements are extracted only from the eight Book I chapter files. External sources are used only for contextual micro-wiki summaries and modern geographic identification.

title: Earth

quality_rules.explicit: Directly stated or unambiguously shown in the chapter text.
quality_rules.strong_inference: Strongly implied by the chapter text but not stated as a completed fact.
quality_rules.weak_inference: Plausible but not sufficiently certain for reader-facing map data.
quality_rules.spoiler_boundary: No later-book information is used to resolve a Book I ambiguity.

critical_corrections: Chapter 1 direction toward Tarui is not treated as confirmed arrival.
Matahachi is physically present only in chapters 1–2; later chapters mention him but do not place him physically in the narrative.
Chapter 4 establishes Ogin's arrest and reports Hinagura as her prison; chapter 7 explicitly reveals that she had already been transferred to Himeji.
Chapter 7 establishes Otsu's route toward Himeji but she becomes ill at Mikazuki Teahouse and is later reported to have recovered and reached Hanada Bridge.
Chapter 8 contains a three-year time jump inside the same source chapter; states before and after the gap must not be conflated.

identity_checkpoint.evidence: Ikeda Terumasa and Takuan explicitly establish the new name during Takezo's release from confinement.
identity_checkpoint.spoiler_rule: The internal character ID remains musashi; only the reader-facing display name changes at the narrative point where the new name is established.
